_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: type $23 ($8D70-$8E67). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): bit 7 set goes to `$8D9B`. Stats: hit points 14 (x 16 = 224 once widened), attack 48, collision flags `$5A`, drawing flags 3, art block `$41`, dies as type 7.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): art wait, hit points
TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): palette, random x
regions.description: Palette 0; `JSR $C0F0` (`$F9E9`): a random x of 32-223 (and y 8, replaced next).

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): the entrance delay
regions.description: `$0788` := `$78` (120 frames) and y := `$C0` (192, the bottom of the playfield, hidden by the status bar).

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): start a jump (also every landing)
regions.description: `JSR $C147` (`$FE79`: all four velocity bytes to 0); the y spring's target `$0668` := `$FB` (251, far below) and the y speed `$05D8` := `$FB` (-5, a kick upward); `JSR $C0A2`. RUN: spawned alone in a corridor state, art block marked loaded, `$41` stepped by hand.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): every frame: the 120-frame wait
regions.description: While `$0788` counts down the boss is only drawn, and only on frames where the value is even: it flickers (read from the code; the log shows `$0788` counting 119 -> 0 with y fixed at 192); no collision.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): gravity and homing
regions.description: `JSR $C09C` with A = `$18`: the y speed is pulled toward the target 251 by 24/256 a frame (gravity, a quarter of a pixel in about 10 frames). `$0680` := the player's x and `JSR $C09F` (`$CD46`) with A = 8: the x speed is pulled toward the player's x by 8/256 a frame. RUN: x moved 154 -> 213 over the first jump, toward the player.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): landing
regions.description: A rising boss (y speed negative) skips to the drawing (`$8E01`); y of `$C0` or more starts the next jump (`$8D8D`). RUN: a jump lasts about 107 frames (up 5 px a frame, apex near y 61 after ~55 frames).

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): volley already fired?
regions.description: `$0638` (the picture phase) of 2 or more skips the volley.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): the mouth animation
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` with step `$40` over 3 phases (0, 1, 2; a new phase every 4 frames); below phase 2 nothing more happens. RUN: the phase became 1 at frame 176 and 2 at frame 180.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): aim
regions.description: `JSR $C0FF` (`$F863`): the direction to the player (slot 0) into `$14`; `$15` := 2.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): the volley
regions.description: Three times: a free slot (`$C108`; none: stop), a type-`$27` bullet (`$C105`, a child at the boss's position) with `$07A0` := 1 and direction `$0788` := the aim + `$8E65[$15]` (0, 4, 12). RUN: three bullets at frame 180 with directions 15, 7, 3 for an aim of 3.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): picture
TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): during the wait: draw only
regions.description: `$0788` non-zero: `JSR $C090` (draw without moving) and on to the second piece.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): move
regions.description: `JSR $C08D` (move by the velocity and draw); carry clear carries on.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): off the side of the screen
regions.description: Carry set (the move left the screen): x := 0, or `$FF` when moving left, and `JMP $C123` (`$FB64`: reverse the x speed). The boss bounces off the screen edges. (Read from the code; the 520-frame run did not reach an edge.)

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): the second piece
regions.description: A piece 40 px above the body (`$84` - `$28`, if that does not wrap), tile base `$07E8,X`, metasprite `$7F`, through `$C093` (`$CC34`): the head or antenna above the body.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): no hits during the wait
regions.description: `$0788` non-zero returns.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): the hit box reaches up
regions.description: `JSR $C0B1` (`$D229`: the box from the metasprite), then the top edge `$0710` is lowered by `$30` (48), so the box covers the piece above as well.

regions.name: TYPE $23 (ZIBZUB, corridor 5's boss): hit test
regions.description: `JSR $C0C9` (`$D297`, mask `$30`), `JMP $C0D8` (`$D39B`, the boss's resolution).

regions.name: Zibzub metasprite by phase
Zibzub tile offset by phase
Zibzub volley direction offsets
regions.description: `00 04 0C` (read from the end): the aim, +4, +12.
